mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.device_code, d.device_name, d.device_type, d.manufacturer, d.model, d.ip_address, d.port, d.location, d.location_desc, d.water_area_id, d.status, d.last_heartbeat, d.extra_config, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.deleted, w.name AS water_area_name FROM device d LEFT JOIN water_area w ON d.water_area_id = w.id WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device ( device_code, device_name, device_type, manufacturer, model, ip_address, port, location, location_desc, water_area_id, status, last_heartbeat, extra_config, created_at, updated_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{device.deviceCode}, #{device.deviceName}, #{device.deviceType}, #{device.manufacturer}, #{device.model}, #{device.ipAddress}, #{device.port}, #{device.location}, #{device.locationDesc}, #{device.waterAreaId}, COALESCE(#{device.status}, 'OFFLINE'), #{device.lastHeartbeat}, #{device.extraConfig, typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, COALESCE(#{device.createdAt}, NOW()), COALESCE(#{device.updatedAt}, NOW()), 0 )
mapper.update:
UPDATE device
device_code = #{device.deviceCode}, device_name = #{device.deviceName}, device_type = #{device.deviceType}, manufacturer = #{device.manufacturer}, model = #{device.model}, ip_address = #{device.ipAddress}, port = #{device.port}, location = #{device.location}, location_desc = #{device.locationDesc}, water_area_id = #{device.waterAreaId}, status = #{device.status}, last_heartbeat = #{device.lastHeartbeat},
extra_config = #{device.extraConfig, typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb,
deleted = #{device.deleted}, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = #{device.id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, device_code, device_name, device_type, manufacturer, model, ip_address, port, location, location_desc, water_area_id, status, last_heartbeat, extra_config, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM device WHERE device_type = #{deviceType} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, device_code, device_name, device_type, manufacturer, model, ip_address, port, location, location_desc, water_area_id, status, last_heartbeat, extra_config, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM device WHERE device_type = #{deviceType} AND status = 'ONLINE' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY ( (cast(split_part(substring(location from '\((.*)\)'), ' ', 1) as double precision) - #{lng}) * (cast(split_part(substring(location from '\((.*)\)'), ' ', 1) as double precision) - #{lng}) + (cast(split_part(substring(location from '\((.*)\)'), ' ', 2) as double precision) - #{lat}) * (cast(split_part(substring(location from '\((.*)\)'), ' ', 2) as double precision) - #{lat}) ) ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, device_code, device_name, device_type, manufacturer, model, ip_address, port, location, location_desc, water_area_id, status, last_heartbeat, extra_config, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM device WHERE device_code = #{deviceCode}
